title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten named campus places for studying, gathering, recreation, meals, performances, and quiet reflection, supported by direct Franciscan University sources.

cards.title: Bring the Project Team to Totus Tuus
cards.subtitle: A purpose-built group room inside St. John Paul II Library
cards.notes: Use the large table for collaborative work, then move ideas onto the room’s chalkboards or whiteboard during project sessions.
cards.short_summary: A student-created library room pairs group-work tools with art inspired by Franciscan’s Austria campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan identifies Totus Tuus as a ground-floor library study room with a large table, chalkboards, a whiteboard, and reference books.
cards.source_title: Franciscan University Students Furbish New Totus Tuus Group Study Room
cards.access_notes: Located on the ground floor of St. John Paul II Library; confirm current library access and room-use procedures.

cards.title: Take Lab Reports Upstairs
cards.subtitle: Top-floor tables in the campus science hall
cards.notes: Bring coursework upstairs when you want table space for a lab report, problem set, or a quieter study session with classmates.
cards.short_summary: The science hall’s top floor offers an officially highlighted setting for focused academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: A Franciscan campus-life feature recommends the top-floor tables in SS. Cosmas and Damian Hall for lab reports, mathematics, and quieter group study.
cards.source_title: Quiz – Where Will You Be on Campus?
cards.access_notes: An academic-building study area; use it during authorized building access and avoid disrupting nearby classes.

cards.title: Switch From Studying to Moving
cards.subtitle: Indoor courts, running, exercise, and major campus gatherings
cards.notes: Check posted facility access, then use the fieldhouse for laps, basketball, weights, or a scheduled student gathering.
cards.short_summary: Finnegan changes roles throughout the year, serving recreation alongside large university events.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan describes Finnegan Fieldhouse as a place where students run laps, shoot basketball, and lift weights; university orientation also schedules student events there.
cards.source_title: Quiz – Where Will You Be on Campus?
cards.access_notes: Student recreation access and hours can change; the university directs students to Student Life updates or the J.C. Williams Center switchboard.

cards.title: Move the Essay Outside
cards.subtitle: Outdoor tables beside Egan Hall
cards.notes: Use the plaza tables for reading or writing when weather permits, while keeping pedestrian routes and building entrances clear.
cards.short_summary: A named academic plaza gives students an outdoor alternative to desks and library tables.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan’s campus-life feature specifically identifies Egan Plaza’s outdoor tables as a place to write essays or study for exams.
cards.source_title: Quiz – Where Will You Be on Campus?
cards.access_notes: Outdoor seating is weather-dependent; follow campus rules and any temporary event or maintenance restrictions.

cards.title: Use the Student Center as Base Camp
cards.subtitle: A central setting for services, meetups, and campus events
cards.notes: Meet here between commitments, check the switchboard for campus updates, or use the building as a starting point for student activities.
cards.short_summary: The student center works as a practical rendezvous point rather than a single-purpose destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan identifies the Williams Center as its campus student center, and current orientation programming places student socials and activities there.
cards.access_notes: Building services and event access vary by schedule; some orientation activities are limited to registered participants.

cards.title: Choose the Meal’s Energy Level
cards.subtitle: The campus dining hall with contrasting upstairs and downstairs settings
cards.notes: Head upstairs for a more social meal or use the downstairs setting when you want a quieter dining break between commitments.
cards.short_summary: Antonian Hall lets students match a campus meal with either conversation or a calmer atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan’s campus-life feature names Antonian Hall as the dining hall and distinguishes its social upstairs area from a quieter downstairs setting.
cards.source_title: Quiz – Where Will You Be on Campus?
cards.access_notes: Dining access may require a meal plan, campus identification, or payment; consult current dining information before visiting.

cards.title: Step Into a Smaller Place for Prayer
cards.subtitle: A campus chapel modeled on the Portiuncula associated with St. Francis
cards.notes: Enter quietly for personal prayer or meditation, and respect any worship, adoration, or capacity guidance posted at the chapel.
cards.short_summary: The small chapel offers a distinct setting for reflection away from larger campus gathering rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan describes its campus Portiuncula as a recreation of the place central to St. Francis’ activity and a haven for meditation and Eucharistic adoration.
cards.access_notes: A sacred space intended for quiet prayer and Eucharistic adoration; observe posted chapel expectations and service schedules.

cards.title: See the Renewed Chapel in Daily Use
cards.subtitle: The expanded central chapel reopened in August 2025
cards.notes: Consult the ministry schedule before attending Mass, a holy hour, or praise and worship, and preserve quiet around active services.
cards.short_summary: The renovated chapel combines regular worship with new sacred art, stained glass, and expanded seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan reports that Christ the King Chapel reopened after renovation in August 2025 with 590 seats, a new altar and tabernacle, sacred art, and stained-glass windows.
cards.source_title: Franciscan University Celebrates Solemn Blessing of Renovated Christ the King Chapel
cards.access_notes: Access should accommodate scheduled liturgies and prayer; check Chapel Ministries for the current service calendar.

cards.title: Find the Newest Academic Crossroads
cards.subtitle: A combined academic and conference building opened in 2024
cards.notes: Use the hall for assigned classes, academic appointments, or scheduled programs, and verify access before entering conference areas.
cards.short_summary: The university’s largest building brings several professional programs and medium-scale events under one roof.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan states that Christ the Teacher Hall opened in August 2024 with academic space for engineering, business, and nursing plus a conference-center wing.
cards.source_title: Franciscan University Opens Christ the Teacher Academic Hall and Conference Center
cards.access_notes: Academic and conference areas may have different access rules; enter for classes, appointments, or scheduled public programs.

cards.title: Catch Student Work on the Egan Stage
cards.subtitle: A named performance venue inside Egan Hall
cards.notes: Watch the university calendar for theatre showcases and productions, then arrive early enough to locate the venue inside Egan Hall.
cards.short_summary: Anathan Theatre gives campus performances a dedicated room within an academic building.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan’s current orientation schedule identifies Anathan Theatre in Egan Hall as the venue for the FUS Theatre Program Showcase.
cards.access_notes: Enter for scheduled performances or programs; ticketing, capacity, and audience access can vary by event.
